items.title: When Dennis Schroder suits up for the Hornets, they will be the 12th NBA team he's played for. That ties Chucky Brown, Jim Jackson, Tony Massenburg, Joe Smith and Garrett Temple for the second-most teams player for in NBA history.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
When Dennis Schroder suits up for the Hornets, they will be the 12th NBA team he's played for. That ties Chucky Brown, Jim Jackson, Tony Massenburg, Joe Smith and Garrett Temple for the second-most teams player for in NBA history.

That's one off Ish Smith's record of 13 teams.
